title: An Orlov theorem for matrix factorizations with multiple factors
summary: We prove a generalization of Orlov's theorem for matrix factorizations with $n$ steps. Let $X$ be a regular scheme, $W\colon X\to \mathbb{A}^1$ a flat morphism and $D:=W^{-1}(0)$ its central fiber. We construct an appropriate triangulated category of matrix factorizations with $n$-steps and show that it is equivalent to the singularity category of the root stack $\sqrt[n]{(X, D)}$. We also show that this category admits a semiorthogonal decomposition into $n-1$ copies of the usual (absolute derived) category of matrix factorizations with $2$ steps.
